S1.why: Masculine plural agreeing with cutlings (vocab: "els teus cutlings"); the noun is understood from the tiles, which keeps it inside 12.

S2.why: Plain tu imperative, as iOS Catalan writes actions; desar is the Catalan word for saving, and the line invites rather than warns.

S3.s: Ja has omplert els teus %lld cutlings gratuïts. Ho seran sempre i no deixaran de funcionar.
S3.back: Already you-have filled the your 5 cutlings free. It they-will-be always and not they-will-stop of working.
S3.why: The pronoun ho stands for "gratuïts", which is how a native says "they stay free" without repeating the word; lowercase cutlings in running text, as the vocab sentence does.

S4.why: "Per estrenar" is the everyday phrase for something new waiting to be used: warmer than "pots desar", same fact.

S5.s: Has fet servir %lld dels %lld cutlings gratuïts.
S5.back: You-have made use 3 of-the 5 cutlings free.
S5.why: Catalan keeps used-then-total order, so plain %lld works; "fer servir" is the spoken verb for use.

S6.why: "Hi caben" is how Catalan says there is room for that many; "Lloc per a…" ran to 25 against a budget of 24, and this is 20.

S7.s: Fins a %@ cutlings de text i %lld d’imatge.
S7.back: Up to 5.000 cutlings of text and 500 of image.
S7.why: Uses the vocab's "Cutling de text" and "Cutling d’imatge"; the second noun is elided, as Catalan does in a pair.

S8.why: Catalan lists with "i" and no comma before it; no articles in a label line.

S9.s: Una sola compra val per a tots tres, amb el teu compte d’Apple.
S9.back: One single purchase counts for to all three, with the your account of-Apple.
S9.why: "Tots tres" is the natural way to say all three; "compte d’Apple" exactly as the vocab writes it.

S10.why: Noun phrase that reads the same in Central, Valencian and Balearic speech; "un cop" or "una volta" would pick a dialect.

S11.s: Sense subscripció, sense anuncis i sense registrar-te.
S11.back: Without subscription, without ads and without registering-yourself.
S11.why: Repeated "sense" is how Catalan stacks negatives; "registrar-te" avoids "compte", which already means the Apple Account on this sheet.

S12.why: The wording Catalan iOS apps use for the App Store restore action, tu imperative.

S13.why: Mirrors S12 so the link keeps its name while it works; the object keeps "Restaurant" from reading as the noun restaurant. Ellipsis character.

S14.why: "Per" is the Catalan preposition for a price; the once-only fact sits in S10 right above, so the button stays short.

S15.why: The same verb as S14, alone, 11 characters.

S16.why: What Catalan iOS says for putting something off: a postponement, not a refusal.

S17.why: The tu imperative iOS Catalan uses on close buttons.

S18.why: Short and a little proud; "tot" takes in the items and the whole grid of room.

S19.s: Gràcies per la compra. Cutling el fa una sola persona, i així l’ajudes.
S19.back: Thanks for the purchase. Cutling it makes one single person, and so her you-help.
S19.why: Topic-first order ("Cutling el fa…") is how Catalan speaks; l’ajudes agrees with "persona", so no gender is guessed for the maker.

S20.s: Hola de nou. La teva compra torna a ser aquí.
S20.back: Hello of new. The your purchase returns to be here.
S20.why: "Hola de nou" greets without a gendered "benvingut/benvinguda"; the restored purchase is the subject.

S21.why: Compact for VoiceOver, which reads it right after the tiles; same order as S5.

S22.s: Cutlings: %lld. Ara hi ha lloc per a %@.
S22.back: Cutlings: 5. Now there is room for to 5.000.
S22.why: Label then number, so it reads right for 1, 2, 5 and 21 with no plural agreement to break; "Cutlings" capitalised as in the list title.

S23.s: Cutling desbloquejat. Ara hi ha lloc per a %@ cutlings.
S23.back: Cutling unlocked. Now there is room for to 5.000 cutlings.
S23.why: Announcement shape: state first, then the room; desbloquejat masculine for the app.

S24.why: Reflexive passive puts the fault on nobody; calm, no blame.

S25.s: Ara mateix no es pot connectar amb l’App Store. Torna-ho a provar d’aquí a una estona.
S25.back: Right now not one can connect with the App Store. Again-it try from here to a while.
S25.why: "Torna-ho a provar" is the standard Catalan retry; "d’aquí a una estona" is how a person says shortly.

S26.s: L’App Store no ha confirmat aquesta compra.
S26.back: The App Store not has confirmed this purchase.
S26.why: Plain fact, l’App Store with the article as Catalan uses it.

S27.s: No hi ha cap compra de Cutling amb el compte d’Apple d’aquest dispositiu.
S27.back: Not there is any purchase of Cutling with the account of-Apple of-this device.
S27.why: "No hi ha cap" is the native negative existential; vocab "compte d’Apple".

S28.s: La versió gratuïta admet %lld cutlings. Desbloqueja Cutling una vegada i desa’n tants com vulguis.
S28.back: The version free admits 5 cutlings. Unlock Cutling one time and save-of-them as-many as you-want.
S28.why: "Desa’n tants com vulguis" uses the partitive en, the natural "as many as you like"; "una vegada" is dialect-neutral; 95 characters.

S29.why: Fits 18; gratuïts agrees with the cutlings named in the title above it.

K1.why: "Ja tens els cinc" is how a speaker says all five are taken; the bare imperative on a tappable capsule is the action; 35 characters.

M1.why: Verb-led command name, as Catalan macOS titles its windows.

M2.why: Same command as M1 with the ellipsis character, because it opens a window.

M3.why: Row label in the list title's capitalised form.

M4.why: "de" is the Catalan way to read a count pair; a slash would read as a date or fraction.

M5.why: Participle as a status, masculine for the app.

M6.s: Una sola compra desbloqueja Cutling a l’iPhone, a l’iPad i al Mac.
M6.back: One single purchase unlocks Cutling on the iPhone, on the iPad and on-the Mac.
M6.why: In a sentence Catalan puts the article and repeats the preposition before each device, as Apple's Catalan pages do.

M7.s: Desbloquejat a l’iPhone, a l’iPad i al Mac amb aquest compte d’Apple.
M7.back: Unlocked on the iPhone, on the iPad and on-the Mac with this account of-Apple.
M7.why: Same device list as M6; vocab "compte d’Apple".

M8.s: Vas comprar Cutling quan encara era de pagament, així que es queda desbloquejat. Gràcies.
M8.back: You-went to-buy Cutling when still it-was of payment, so that itself stays unlocked. Thanks.
M8.why: "De pagament" is the everyday opposite of "de franc"; the thanks stands alone at the end, as a person would say it.
